settings.title: Pick an amount
settings.text: Choose $10 to $100 and add a personal message if you want to send it as a gift.

settings.title: They get it by email
settings.text: The card arrives with your note, on the day you pick.

settings.title: They choose their meals
settings.text: They build their week from the menu, and we deliver it fresh.

settings.question: Can they use it on any meal plan?
settings.answer: Yes. The balance applies at checkout to any meal plan on the menu.

settings.question: How does the recipient get the card?
settings.answer: By email, on the date you choose. If you pick no date, it is sent right after checkout.

settings.question: Can I buy more than one?
settings.answer: Yes. Add as many cards as you like, in any mix of amounts.
